kept.spine: Nothing in Warmholz is arranged for buying and selling in quantity, and goods change hands at the door of whoever has them.
No task here has been made official while somebody can do it on the side.
The hamlet bends this far and no further without becoming a different place.
Things here get worse by degrees rather than all at once, and each season asks a little more of the same households.
The year here closes near enough to level that the closing itself is watched.
More happens to the people here than anybody keeps an account of.
This place pays its own way on the terms it has.
What stands between the hamlet and trouble is less than a place this size usually keeps.
What has kept this place is that nobody has wanted it, and everyone here understands the arrangement.
Plenty goes on here that nobody troubles to look into, though little of it is hidden.
The place keeps nothing spare, and that is the first thing about it a person notices.
Nobody here works magic, and no arrangement has been made with anyone who does.
Nobody in Warmholz thinks about food.
Everything that reaches the hamlet reaches it by the road.
Warmholz is a handful of roofs around a green, and the reason for the roofs is the ground under them.
The people of Warmholz are tied to one another the way the people of any settled place are, and nothing beyond that holds them together.
A careful eye finds a loose end here, and nothing here has ever been set up to tie it off.
